title: Thesis Benchmark Results
source_note: Stored results reported in the dissertation. These values are not recalculated from the document currently loaded in the browser.

benchmark_sets.title: Complex Reasoning Benchmark
benchmark_sets.description: The primary benchmark for comparison, multi-hop, graph, and missing-information questions.

metrics.label: Thesis complex reasoning score
metrics.interpretation: Primary weighted result for the thesis complex-reasoning tasks.

metrics.label: Ground-truth keyword F1
metrics.interpretation: Agentic was slightly lower on concise keyword precision.

metrics.label: Ground-truth keyword coverage
metrics.interpretation: Agentic covered more required answer points.

metrics.label: Missing-information accuracy
metrics.interpretation: Agentic more consistently identified when the document did not provide the requested evidence.

metrics.label: Multi-hop coverage
metrics.interpretation: Agentic covered more linked pieces of evidence.

metrics.label: Graph reasoning success
metrics.interpretation: Agentic performed better on entity-relationship reasoning questions.

metrics.label: Evidence support rate
metrics.interpretation: More retrieved context did not improve this support measure.

metrics.label: Citation rate
metrics.interpretation: Both workflows already produced citations for most answers.

metrics.label: Citation-based context usage
metrics.interpretation: Agentic's larger context set was used less efficiently under this measure.

metrics.label: Average answer length
metrics.interpretation: The quality difference cannot be explained only by longer answers.

metrics.label: Average end-to-end latency
metrics.interpretation: The full Agentic workflow has a substantial operational cost.

metrics.label: Average retrieved chunks
metrics.interpretation: Agentic used a broader evidence set.

benchmark_sets.title: Multi-document Benchmark
benchmark_sets.description: A general document-question benchmark showing that Agentic is not better on every normal question.

metrics.label: Ground-truth keyword coverage
metrics.interpretation: The coverage gain was small on general document questions.

metrics.label: Citation-based context usage
metrics.interpretation: The broader Agentic context was less efficiently used under this measure.

metrics.label: Average end-to-end latency
metrics.interpretation: The Agentic workflow was more than five times slower.

metrics.label: Average retrieved chunks
metrics.interpretation: Agentic retrieved one additional chunk on average.
